SimpleModelAdmin: CLASS.description: Registers the given model class with the given ModelAdmin.

TabularInlineAdmin: CLASS.description: TabularInline layout for the forms representing the inline objects.

StackedInlineAdmin: CLASS.description: StackedInline layout for the forms representing the inline objects.

@admin.action: METHOD.description: Decorator for defining a custom admin action.

actions: ADMIN-OPT.description: A list of actions to make available on the change list page.

actions_on_top/bottom: ADMIN-OPT.description: Controls where on the page the actions bar appears.

date_hierarchy: ADMIN-OPT.description: Include a date-based drilldown navigation by that field on the change list page.

empty_value_display: ADMIN-OPT.description: Overrides the default display value for record's fields that are empty.

exclude: ADMIN-OPT.description: A list of field names to exclude from the form.

fields: ADMIN-OPT.description: Make simple layout changes in the forms on the add and change pages.

fieldsets: ADMIN-OPT.description: Control the layout of admin add and change pages (group sections).

filter_horizontal: ADMIN-OPT.description: Use a nifty unobtrusive JavaScript horizontal filter interface for ManyToManyField.

filter_vertical: ADMIN-OPT.description: Same as filter_horizontal, but uses a vertical display of the filter interface.

form: ADMIN-OPT.description: Provide your own ModelForm to override any default form behavior on the add/change pages.

formfield_overrides: ADMIN-OPT.description: Override some of the Field options for use in the admin (e.g., custom widgets).

inlines: ADMIN-OPT.description: Specify inline models to be edited on the same page as a parent model.

list_display: ADMIN-OPT.description: Control which fields are displayed on the change list page of the admin.

list_display_links: ADMIN-OPT.description: Control if and which fields in list_display should be linked to the change page for an object.

list_editable: ADMIN-OPT.description: A list of field names on the model which will allow editing on the change list page.

list_filter: ADMIN-OPT.description: Activate filters in the right sidebar of the change list page of the admin.

list_max_show_all: ADMIN-OPT.description: Control how many items can appear on a 'Show all' admin change list page.

list_per_page: ADMIN-OPT.description: Control how many items appear on each paginated admin change list page.

list_select_related: ADMIN-OPT.description: Tell Django to use select_related() in retrieving the list of objects on the admin change list page.

ordering: ADMIN-OPT.description: Specify how lists of objects should be ordered in the Django admin views.

prepopulated_fields: ADMIN-OPT.description: Dictionary mapping field names to the fields it should prepopulate from (e.g., dynamically set a slug).

preserve_filters: ADMIN-OPT.description: Control whether applied filters are preserved on the list view after creating, editing, or deleting an object.

show_facets: ADMIN-OPT.description: Controls whether facet counts are displayed for filters in the admin changelist.

radio_fields: ADMIN-OPT.description: Django uses a radio-button interface instead of a select-box for fields that are ForeignKey or have choices set.

autocomplete_fields: ADMIN-OPT.description: Change ForeignKey and/or ManyToManyField fields to Select2 autocomplete inputs.

raw_id_fields: ADMIN-OPT.description: Change into an Input widget for either a ForeignKey or ManyToManyField.

readonly_fields: ADMIN-OPT.description: Fields will display their data as-is and non-editable; excluded from the ModelForm.

save_as: ADMIN-OPT.description: Enable a 'save as new' feature on admin change forms.

save_as_continue: ADMIN-OPT.description: Control whether the redirect after saving the new object is to the change view.

save_on_top: ADMIN-OPT.description: Add save buttons across the top of your admin change forms.

search_fields: ADMIN-OPT.description: Enable a search box on the admin change list page for specified text fields.

search_help_text: ADMIN-OPT.description: Specify descriptive text for the search box which will be displayed below it.

show_full_result_count: ADMIN-OPT.description: Control whether the full count of objects should be displayed on a filtered admin page.

sortable_by: ADMIN-OPT.description: Disable sorting for some columns by setting sortable_by to a collection.

view_on_site: ADMIN-OPT.description: Control whether or not to display the 'View on site' link.
